motivation.interpretation: Treat upstream visual orientation and goal grounding as the dominant failure hypothesis rather than stacking more execution heuristics.

known_limits: Connected-component tracking is a generic visual primitive, not full scene segmentation.
Multi-part co-moving entities are exposed to the semantic model but are not automatically promoted to a composite exact planner actor.
Counterfactual scores are causal priors, not learned hidden-game rules.
Kaggle RTX Save & Run and private leaderboard transfer remain unvalidated until the exact S160 artifact is executed.
